first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person facing away from the camera, with long reddish-brown braided hair, dark reddish-brown layered clothing and armor, and a segmented waist skirt outlined in light brown.

entities.name: light-colored branching dirt path
entities.identification: A nearby light-brown, stone-inlaid road surface connecting in the distance to a dirt-and-stone path with a light-colored left branch and a reddish-brown right branch.

entities.name: woodland with green vegetation and red shrubs
entities.identification: A set of environmental vegetation composed of low green foliage, bands of red shrubs, and taller trees on both sides of the road.

entities.name: moss-covered rock outcrop
entities.identification: A gray-brown rocky hill covered in dark green on the right, as well as a light-gray rock face exposed in the distance on the left.

entities.name: blue sky and white clouds
entities.identification: Pale blue sky and white and grayish-white cloud masses between the treetops in the upper part of the image.

entities.name: bow-shaped long weapon carried on the back
entities.identification: Person A's slender bow-shaped equipment positioned diagonally behind their back, with alternating dark-brown and light gray-brown sections and a thin end extending beyond the shoulder.

entities.name: white mist among the trees
entities.identification: A translucent milky-white misty area with soft edges among the trees in the mid-to-far ground.

entities.name: slanting light through the trees
entities.identification: Soft-edged, pale-white diagonal bands of light on the forested slope on the right and within the mist layer in the mid-to-far ground.

entities.name: bottom-left status icon
entities.identification: White numbers, outlines, small icons, and a green cross overlaid in the bottom-left corner of the image.
